title: Overall accuracy
headline: Company weekly revenue forecasts were 97.3% accurate over 24 tested weeks, with errors 81.0% smaller than repeating last year's sales.
source_numbers: company accuracy 97.3%; last year's pattern 86.0%; error reduction 81.0%; tested weeks 24

title: Strongest and weakest areas
headline: California is the most accurate state (97.4%) and Wisconsin the least (96.0%); by store, CA_1 is strongest (97.5%) and CA_2 weakest (93.5%). 3 of 3 states and 10 of 10 stores beat last year's pattern.

title: Next 4 weeks outlook
headline: Company accuracy stays between 96.7% and 97.7% from 1 to 4 weeks ahead. In the latest tested 4 weeks (2016-04-23 to 2016-05-14) the forecast was $3.72 million against $3.88 million actual (4.1% below), inside the likely range in 1 of 4 weeks.
source_numbers: 1 week ahead 97.7%; 2 weeks ahead 96.7%; 3 weeks ahead 97.2%; 4 weeks ahead 97.7%; latest forecast 3721724.28; latest actual 3881400.69

title: What to do
headline: Use the forecast for company and state revenue planning (97.3% accurate, ahead of last year's pattern everywhere), and hold a wider buffer at CA_2 and WI_2, the 2 stores below 95% accuracy, reviewing them weekly.
